component: Button variants (primary, destructive) and async action button
need: Partly implemented: disabled and aria-busy button states exist (components.css ~5751); primary (outside marketing scope) and destructive variants missing.
workaround_r1: Use native button with text labels; confirm destructive actions via dialog (G-005); disable the button and show operation-status while pending. Acceptable for design; not for production visual hierarchy.
acceptance: data-forma-variant=primary|destructive styles exist in components.css outside the marketing scope; an aria-busy button state is styled and announced; axe passes.
filed_as: kemiller2002/forma#186 (narrowed: busy and disabled states already exist)

component: Field invalid, disabled and read-only styling
need: Implemented at d7c499e (foundations.css 160-177); remaining: contrast browser test and correcting COMPONENT-INVENTORY, which still lists it as unimplemented.
workaround_r1: Use as shipped.
acceptance: :disabled, :read-only, [aria-invalid=true] and :user-invalid styles exist in foundations.css with 3:1 non-text contrast; a browser test proves each.
filed_as: kemiller2002/forma#187 (corrected: styles exist at d7c499e; contrast test and inventory correction remain)

component: Data table styling for plain table
need: Not required by release-1 designs: data-grid and dense-ledger cover all tables.
workaround_r1: Use data-grid or dense-ledger.
acceptance: n/a for release 1
filed_as: not filed: not needed for release 1

component: Bulk action bar
need: Not required by release 1: the exception inbox has no bulk actions by design (each decision is individual). One-click batch approval (RCD-005) is a single dialog listing items.
workaround_r1: dialog + data-grid
acceptance: n/a for release 1
filed_as: not filed: not needed for release 1

component: Visualization primitives and chart accessibility contract
need: Trend views for sponsor overview and investment performance (post release 1).
workaround_r1: Tables and metric-value-change only (S-011).
acceptance: A chart primitive with a mandatory text-table equivalent and axe-tested contrast.

component: Letter primitives (letterhead, address block, signature block)
need: Acknowledgments and remittances are letters.
workaround_r1: Compose from ef-print-header and ef-print-section with semantic address and paragraph markup (proven in design prototype D-001).
acceptance: Documented recipe or primitives with print-position rules for window envelopes (address block at a fixed position).

component: Verification code and document identity block
need: Each issued document shows its reference and a verification code or URL that resolves in the document registry (REQ-X-034).
workaround_r1: Text verification code inside ef-print-footer; QR code generation is Unbound-owned (SVG).
acceptance: Footer shows the reference and the verification URL; the registry resolves the hash.

component: Deterministic server-side PDF rendering (P2) and batch generation
need: Monthly statements for every fund, re-renderable byte-for-byte or with a stable content hash.
workaround_r1: Headless Chromium print-to-PDF from the Folio HTML (~0.25 s per document). Measured: per-page text hash stable 7/7; raw bytes identical 7/7 once /CreationDate and /ModDate are stripped, so the render service MUST set fixed metadata dates from the snapshot.
acceptance: Re-rendering the same snapshot yields an identical normalized content hash; throughput is measured.

component: Widget host, frame protocol and scoped tokens
need: Read-only embedded status (W-001).
workaround_r1: Plain iframe with server-issued short-lived token; no postMessage commands in release 1.
acceptance: CSP frame-ancestors restricted to registered partner origins; token TTL ≤ 10 minutes; no PII beyond the card.

component: ef-print-page-number / P1-P2 page counters
need: 'Page n of N' on every page (D-002, all multi-page documents).
workaround_r1: Unbound render service injects the @page margin-box counter rule at render time (measured: passes 7/7 documents). Remove when Folio ships the rule.
acceptance: With no consumer CSS, ef-print-footer[repeat=page] containing ef-print-page-number[format=page-of-pages] yields 'Page n of N' on every body page in P1/P2 Chromium; P0 strict mode fails export instead of printing fallback text.

component: Running header/footer (repeat=page) and per-section running content
need: Reference (G-016), legal-sponsor disclosure (G-014) and verification code on every page; correct identity per document unit.
workaround_r1: Render-time @page margin boxes for reference and page number (measured 7/7); disclosure repeated in a final section; one document per PDF (no multi-unit PDFs) in release 1.
acceptance: Running slots print on every page of their profile, never fragment, reserve margin space, and can be set per section; pdftotext shows reference and disclosure on every page of a 70-row statement.

component: Unbroken identifier / reference text treatment
need: References, EINs, URLs and hashes must print and extract intact.
workaround_r1: Shorten verification URL to a short code plus registry host; put hashes in their own full-width row; accept wrapping of hashes in release 1.
acceptance: A primitive keeps identifiers of 32 characters or fewer and dates unbroken; pdftotext output of each identifier equals the source string.

component: Letter address block at fixed window-envelope position
need: Mailed acknowledgments and remittances (D-001, D-003).
workaround_r1: Release 1 delivers acknowledgments electronically (E-SIGN consent, counsel Q10); mailed letters use a fixed-height letterhead so the address lands in the window, verified per brand.
acceptance: An address primitive places its box at a configurable fixed page position (e.g. #10 window 0.875in/2.0in, 4.0x1.125in); pdftotext -bbox confirms for any letterhead length.

component: Multi-page table totals printed once
need: Statement grand totals must not repeat on every page (D-002).
workaround_r1: Move totals out of tfoot into a following summary block (ef-print-keep).
acceptance: ef-print-table[footer=final] prints tfoot only on the last fragment; carried-forward subtotal pattern documented and tested.

component: Heading keep-with-next by default
need: No orphaned headings above page breaks.
workaround_r1: Use the .ef-dense recipe on all Unbound documents (measured: no orphan).
acceptance: Component layer applies break-after: avoid to h1-h6 before blocks and tables; fixture shows no heading in the last 10% of a page.

component: ef-print-toc target page numbers
need: Tables of contents with page numbers (D-002, D-006).
workaround_r1: Two-pass render in the Unbound render service fills data-page from the first-pass PDF; or omit page numbers in release 1.
acceptance: P2 export fills [data-page] from a first-pass layout; numbers match the PDF.

component: Tagged PDF in the P2 export contract
need: Distributed PDFs should be tagged; RCD-009 makes the HTML twin the accessible rendition.
workaround_r1: Render with Chromium tagged:true and outline:true (measured: Tagged: yes); HTML twin remains the conformance rendition.
acceptance: P2 pins tagged:true; structure validated by a PDF/UA checker (veraPDF or PAC) with documented limits.

component: Signature / approval block recipe
need: Preparer/signer (D-004) and decider (D-005) blocks.
workaround_r1: ef-meta-list inside ef-print-keep.
acceptance: Recipe with name, role, date and signature evidence, kept together, semantic dl, three documented examples.

component: Application shell (.forma-app-shell) with footer legal-note slot
need: One application frame with gutters, header, nav, main and a footer holding the legal-sponsor disclosure (G-014).
workaround_r1: Compose .forma-site + .forma-site__main + site-footer around navigation-shell (all 14 prototypes).
acceptance: .forma-app-shell ships with regions and a legal-note slot, works without .forma-site, 0 axe violations and no horizontal scroll at 320/1280.

component: Copyable identifier
need: Copy control for record references (G-016).
workaround_r1: Plain Copy button beside forma-identifier; announcement via application.
acceptance: Button named 'Copy <label> <value>', status announcement, 24x24 target, wraps at 320 px.

component: Numeric/money value presentation
need: Amounts intact, tabular numerals, end-aligned numeric columns, labelled negatives (G-017).
workaround_r1: Avoid 3-column metric grids for large amounts; use key-value-list and dense-ledger; accept proportional digits in release 1 design review only.
acceptance: Numeric value hook with tabular numerals and no mid-number break in metric-card, data-grid (end-aligned) and key-value dd.

component: Multi-dimension status track
need: Five grant dimensions each with state and as-of time plus headline (G-002).
workaround_r1: steps items each containing status-lozenge and time (composition proven in S-004, S-005).
acceptance: Per-item data-state ok/attention/unknown/blocked/neutral with label and time, headline slot, list semantics, forced-colors proof.

component: Unavailable-action pattern (disabled control with visible reason)
need: Segregation-of-duties and required-notice reasons visible (S-009, S-010, S-013).
workaround_r1: Ad-hoc reason text linked via aria-describedby; keep reason outside disabled switch description.
acceptance: Disabled control plus visible reason at >= 4.5:1, linked by aria-describedby, in button rows, record-header, obligation-panel and switch.

component: Read-only allocation summary
need: Text equivalent of a successor percentage split (S-006).
workaround_r1: Ordered list with names and shares.
acceptance: Read-only allocation summary with names, shares, total and as-of version, list semantics.

component: feed-item canonical markup defect (data-state=warning)
need: Canonical patterns must use the lozenge vocabulary.
workaround_r1: Unbound uses data-state=attention.
acceptance: Pattern fixed; catalog test rejects unknown data-state values.

component: Dialog confirmation variant with pinned header and actions
need: Consequence preview usable on a phone (G-005).
workaround_r1: Limit phone confirmation to 4 key consequence rows with a 'Show all details' disclosure.
acceptance: Pinned title + key consequence and pinned action row; tested at 320x568 and 320x800.

component: Container-query reflow (collection-toolbar, obligation-panel, shells)
need: Components inside panes reflow by container width (S-008, S-009).
workaround_r1: Place toolbar above workspace-shell and obligation-panel in the primary column (working layouts used in prototypes).
acceptance: Container queries; screenshot tests in a 20rem pane at 1280 px show no clipped or single-word lines.

component: AI output provenance label and action-free handoff-summary
need: AI output labelled with sources; no consequential controls in AI panels (G-011).
workaround_r1: callout with the label plus evidence-relationship for sources; handoff-summary without actions.
acceptance: Label and sources slot in conversation turns; action-free handoff-summary variant documented.

component: Flyout keyboard-scrollable body (axe scrollable-region-focusable)
need: Keyboard access to overflowing flyout content.
workaround_r1: role=region tabindex=0 aria-label on .forma-flyout__body.
acceptance: Canonical markup fixed; axe test with overflowing text passes.

component: Application type scale and density switch
need: Forma's heading sizes are marketing display sizes (fluid-display-1 to 7.25rem, h1 measure 14ch, h2 18ch); there is no application type scale and no density token (comfortable/compact).
workaround_r1: Unbound layer sets --unb-type-* and component sizes (v2/unbound-app.css)
acceptance: An application scope (e.g. data-forma-context=app) applies a fixed type scale with no heading measure, and a density attribute switches row heights and paddings for data components

component: Breakpoint tokens
need: Components hard-code media queries (48rem); no shared breakpoint tokens for applications to align layout ranges.
workaround_r1: Unbound uses 48rem/64rem constants
acceptance: Documented breakpoint values exported as tokens and used by Forma's own components

component: Raised/sunken/chrome surface roles and elevation tokens
need: Forma has surface primary/secondary/inverse only; applications need raised panel, sunken and chrome roles plus elevation, derived per brand. The Echelon theme defines them only for data-forma-brand=echelon, so sponsor brands do not get them.
workaround_r1: Unbound derives them with color-mix from --forma-color-* tokens
acceptance: Brand manifests compile raised/sunken/chrome and elevation roles with contrast checks; a panel component uses them

component: Sentence-case status chip
need: status-lozenge renders uppercase monospace at 11px; on donor surfaces the most important fact becomes the smallest, most technical text (v1 audit UXD-012).
workaround_r1: Unbound .unb-chip (glyph + words, body face 13px)
acceptance: A status-lozenge variant in body face and sentence case, keeping glyph, border and forced-colours behaviour

component: Task list (needs-your-attention) pattern
need: work-queue targets staff queues; donors need a compact list of tasks each with icon, title, reason and one action.
workaround_r1: Unbound .unb-task
acceptance: A task-list pattern with exactly-one-primary-action guidance and resolution semantics

component: Domain icons for giving and payments
need: The 80-icon registry has no glyphs for grant/gift, contribution/deposit, charity/organization, bank or certificate.
workaround_r1: Closest registry icons (send, add, globe)
acceptance: Registry adds reviewed domain-neutral icons: gift, bank, building, receipt, certificate

component: Approval quorum tracker (two or more distinct approvers)
need: Restatement, tolerance override, disposition batches, cutover and two-person approvals need a tracker of required approvers, each with status and independence rule (not the preparer). readiness-checklist only approximates it.
workaround_r1: readiness-checklist with text per approver
acceptance: A component listing required approvals with approver, status, time and an explicit 'cannot be the preparer' rule, announced on change

component: Accounting period context bar
need: Finance workspaces need a persistent header with period, period state (open, closing, certified), cutoff and snapshot as-of/known-at times; scope-trail and date-range do not carry period state.
workaround_r1: scope-trail plus freshness
acceptance: A context bar component with period state and two timestamps, copyable, with forced-colours support

component: Per-item batch outcome summary
need: Batch approval commits each item in its own transaction, so results are mixed (approved, in review, waiting for funds, unknown); FORMA-GAP-04 assumed a single outcome.
workaround_r1: Table of items with status chips
acceptance: A summary that groups items by outcome with counts and links, and treats Unknown distinctly (G-006)

component: Typed panel slot registry for the case workspace
need: The case frame (S-014) hosts 18 typed decision panels; a registry maps case type to panel, required facts and permitted actions.
workaround_r1: Static mapping in the prototype
acceptance: Registry data validated against WFM transitions; unknown case types render a safe read-only panel
